svg.desc: p1: sift 0.20, sift (positions off) 0.19, Elasticsearch 0.30, pg_search 0.51, pg_textsearch 340, rum 20.96, pgx-bm25 4.67; p2: sift 0.21, sift (positions off) 0.23, Elasticsearch 0.29, pg_search 0.58, pg_textsearch 74.94, rum 5.15, pgx-bm25 1.17; p3: sift 0.18, sift (positions off) 0.19, Elasticsearch 0.27, pg_search 0.61, pg_textsearch 12.12, rum 2.01, pgx-bm25 26.06; p4: sift 0.18, sift (positions off) 0.19, Elasticsearch 0.24, pg_search 0.62, pg_textsearch 3.31, rum 0.43, pgx-bm25 2.65; w1: sift 0.14, sift (positions off) 0.15, Elasticsearch 0.19, pg_search 0.71, pg_textsearch 2.93, rum 0.26, pgx-bm25 1.33; a2: sift 0.16, sift (positions off) 0.17, Elasticsearch 0.19, pg_search 0.81, pg_textsearch 2.75, rum 3.46, pgx-bm25 2.03; a2s: sift 0.16, sift (positions off) 0.17, Elasticsearch 0.19, pg_search 0.75, pg_textsearch 2.85, rum 9.01, pgx-bm25 4.44; a3: sift 0.18, sift (positions off) 0.19, Elasticsearch 0.24, pg_search 1.25, pg_textsearch 2.85, rum 3.77, pgx-bm25 5.06; x2: sift 0.17, sift (positions off) 0.17, Elasticsearch 0.22, pg_search 0.99, pg_textsearch 2.81, rum 2.70, pgx-bm25 3.97
svg.text: p50 milliseconds, logarithmic axis, lower is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP, edge n-grams of the typed words expanded by the client.
pg_textsearch: emulation (edge n-gram text, it has no native prefix scoring), see docs/BENCHMARKS.md.
p1-p4: 1-4 letter prefix; w1: whole word; a2, a2s: word + 2 or 1 letter prefix; a3, x2: 3 or 2 prefixes
GeoNames cities15000, 34,179 places, top-20, 1 client, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 5-6); Oct 2026.
